lessonTitle: 38. Sections of a sphere by a plane
lessonTitleEnglish: Sections of a sphere by a plane
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A plane cuts a sphere in a circle; if the centre is at distance d from the plane, the circle's radius is r = √(R² − d²).
stages.headlineEnglish: A plane cuts a sphere in a circle; if the centre is at distance d from the plane, the circle's radius is r = √(R² − d²).

stages.headline: A plane through the centre gives a great circle (r = R); if d > R the plane misses the sphere.
stages.headlineEnglish: A plane through the centre gives a great circle (r = R); if d > R the plane misses the sphere.

stages.headline: Example: R = 10, d = 6 gives r = √(100 − 36) = 8 and section area 64π.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: R = 10, d = 6 gives r = √(100 − 36) = 8 and section area 64π.
